brief:
Survivors in Gaza report that the scale of loss and ongoing violence prevents any meaningful healing from psychological wounds inflicted by the conflict, Al Jazeera English reported. Those who endured the violence describe themselves as broken, with recovery appearing unattainable under current conditions.

The persistent nature of the crisis leaves little room for the mental health support or stability typically required for trauma recovery. Survivors emphasize that rebuilding—both psychological and otherwise—cannot begin while the conflict continues and basic security remains absent.
dek: The genocide has killed many and left the rest broken. For us, survivors, recovery is not on the horizon.
title: Gaza survivors say trauma recovery remains impossible during conflict
